description: Image Description: The image features a suspended installation consisting of a black umbrella and a colorful box. The umbrella is open and positioned above the box, with its handle extending downward to connect to the top of the box via a thin white string or rod. The box is cube-shaped and wrapped in vibrant, patterned paper with a floral design, predominantly featuring blue, red, and white colors. The entire assembly appears to be floating or hanging from the ceiling of a large indoor space, likely a public building
